>>> help group
group commands:
  group build <name|#index>       Build all devices in a group
  group disable <name|#index>     Disable all devices in a group
  group enable <name|#index>      Enable all devices in a group
  group list [filter]             List all groups

<<<
>>> help device
device commands:
  device add <type>               Add a new device
  device bypass <name>            Toggle bypass on a device
  device delete <name>            Delete a device
  device disable <name>           Disable a device
  device enable <name>            Enable a device
  device info                     Show info about selected device
  device list [filter]            List all devices
  device organize                 Organize devices by processing order
  device rename <oldname> <newname>  Rename a device
  device select <name>            Select a device by name
